grader.success: Candidate forward logits match a fresh trusted-baseline forward pass; candidate gradient summaries contain finite nonzero selected-expert and router gradients; and source changes are limited to the pinned route-index detach. The restricted patch-contract requires exactly one simple assignment target, exactly one positional argument, and no keyword arguments at each accepted mx.stop_gradient call. Equivalent source shapes outside this contract may be rejected, so this is not a general repository-repair success metric. The upstream pytest test is not imported or executed; its hash and selectors are retained for provenance only.
